Title: Build Failure - Duplicate nextConfig Declaration
Evidence: next.config.ts:13 and :35 declare const nextConfig twice; next build fails with SyntaxError
Recommended_Action: Merge the two declarations into one preserving the redirects() function
Acceptance_Criteria: next build completes successfully

Title: No Content-Security-Policy Header
Evidence: next.config.ts:6-11 securityHeaders array lacks CSP
Recommended_Action: Add CSP header starting with report-only mode then enforce
Acceptance_Criteria: CSP header present on all responses

Title: In-Memory Rate Limiting Breaks Under Scaling
Evidence: src/lib/ratelimit.ts:7 uses per-process Map
Recommended_Action: Move rate limiting to shared store (Redis/Upstash/Postgres)
Acceptance_Criteria: Rate limits enforced consistently across instances

Title: Zero Automated Test Coverage
Evidence: package.json has no test script; no test files exist
Recommended_Action: Add Vitest and write tests for auth Stripe webhooks and input validation
Acceptance_Criteria: npm test passes with >80% coverage on critical paths

Title: TypeScript Errors Ship to Production
Evidence: next.config.ts:16 ignoreBuildErrors true; tsc reports 3 errors
Recommended_Action: Remove ignoreBuildErrors and fix all TypeScript errors
Acceptance_Criteria: npx tsc --noEmit exits 0

Title: .env Contains Live Database Credentials
Evidence: .env:1-5 contains production Neon DB credentials (redacted)
Recommended_Action: Verify .env not in git history; rotate credentials if needed
Acceptance_Criteria: git log --all --full-history -- .env returns nothing

Title: after() Callbacks Can Be Lost on Server Crash
Evidence: src/app/api/session/route.ts:116-122 and others use after() for critical emails
Recommended_Action: Send password reset and enterprise emails inline; keep after() for non-critical
Acceptance_Criteria: Password reset emails send reliably even under server load

Title: Gas Price Cron Uses Hardcoded Mock Data
Evidence: src/app/api/cron/gas-update/route.ts:19-23 has fake prices
Recommended_Action: Return 503 in production until real scraper is built
Acceptance_Criteria: Cron does not insert mock data in production

Title: Duplicate actorKey Function
Evidence: src/lib/actor.ts:7-11 and src/app/api/incidents/[id]/updates/route.ts:25-29
Recommended_Action: Remove duplicate from route file and import from src/lib/actor.ts
Acceptance_Criteria: actorKey defined only in src/lib/actor.ts

Title: Duplicate UUID_RE Regex
Evidence: src/lib/validate.ts:1 and src/app/api/incidents/[id]/route.ts:10
Recommended_Action: Remove duplicate from route file and import from src/lib/validate.ts
Acceptance_Criteria: UUID_RE defined only in src/lib/validate.ts

Title: escapeHtml() Does Not Escape Single Quotes
Evidence: src/lib/mail.ts:16 escapes & < > but not single quote
Recommended_Action: Add .replace(/'/g ""'"") to the escape chain
Acceptance_Criteria: escapeHtml single quote returns '

Title: No Database Migration Files
Evidence: src/db/ has schema.ts but no drizzle-kit migration output
Recommended_Action: Run npx drizzle-kit generate and commit migration files
Acceptance_Criteria: Migration files exist and drizzle-kit migrate runs in deployment

Title: No Structured Logging or Request Tracing
Evidence: console.error/warn used directly throughout codebase
Recommended_Action: Add structured logger with request IDs via AsyncLocalStorage
Acceptance_Criteria: All logs include requestId userId path duration as JSON

Title: Leftover Build Artifacts and Temp Files
Evidence: temp_prebuild/ temp_prebuild_dir/ New Text Document.txt tsc-full.log exist
Recommended_Action: Add to .gitignore and delete
Acceptance_Criteria: Files removed and .gitignore updated

Title: getViewer() DB Query on Every Request
Evidence: src/lib/viewer.ts:61 queries users table per authenticated request
Recommended_Action: Defer; if scaling add Redis cache with 5s TTL
Acceptance_Criteria: N/A

Title: clientIp() Trusts X-Forwarded-For Without Validation
Evidence: src/lib/ratelimit.ts:11-13 reads X-Forwarded-For directly
Recommended_Action: Add comment documenting assumption; verify proxy config
Acceptance_Criteria: Comment added and proxy confirmed

Title: news/route.ts Triggers Ingest on Every GET
Evidence: src/app/api/news/route.ts:13 calls after(() => refreshIfStale()) on every request
Recommended_Action: Add shorter-circuit check or move to cron
Acceptance_Criteria: Ingest triggered at most once per 5 minutes

Title: smtp.ts Uses Hardcoded nowbey.app Domain
Evidence: src/lib/smtp.ts:65 and :80 hardcode nowbey.app
Recommended_Action: Make domain configurable via SMTP_DOMAIN env var
Acceptance_Criteria: Domain read from env var with nowbey.app default

Title: Add Skip-to-Content Link
Evidence: No skip navigation link in AppShell
Recommended_Action: Add visually-hidden skip link as first element in AppShell
Acceptance_Criteria: Keyboard users can skip to main content

Title: Add ARIA Labels to Icon-Only Buttons
Evidence: ModeToggle and SessionChip may lack accessible names
Recommended_Action: Add aria-label to all icon-only buttons
Acceptance_Criteria: All icon buttons have accessible names

Title: Ensure Focus Visible on All Interactive Elements
Evidence: Custom focus styles may not meet 3:1 contrast
Recommended_Action: Add :focus-visible styles with high-contrast outlines
Acceptance_Criteria: Focus indicator visible on all interactive elements

Title: Add Loading States to Forms
Evidence: Form submissions may not show loading indicators
Recommended_Action: Add disabled state and spinner to submit buttons
Acceptance_Criteria: Submit buttons show loading state during async operations

Title: Add Error Recovery to Photo Uploads
Evidence: Photo processing failures may not show per-photo errors
Recommended_Action: Show per-photo error messages with retry option
Acceptance_Criteria: Users can identify and retry failed photo uploads

Title: Verify Color Contrast Ratios
Evidence: Custom color palette may not meet WCAG AA
Recommended_Action: Run automated contrast check and fix failures
Acceptance_Criteria: All text meets 4.5:1 contrast ratio

Title: Offline-First Mobile Experience
Evidence: Rural islands have limited connectivity; app is unusable offline
Recommended_Action: Cache recent incidents and news in AsyncStorage; show cached data when offline
Acceptance_Criteria: App works offline with cached data

Title: Emergency Services Integration
Evidence: Residents don't know which emergency services are available during disasters
Recommended_Action: Add Services layer to map showing shelters hospitals gas stations
Acceptance_Criteria: Service locations displayed on map with real-time status

Title: Community Verification Badges
Evidence: Residents don't know which reports are trustworthy
Recommended_Action: Show Verified by N neighbours badge on reports with 3+ confirmations
Acceptance_Criteria: Badge displayed on confirmed reports

Title: Local Business Claims
Evidence: Business owners cannot manage their own listings
Recommended_Action: Allow businesses to claim a place edit hours/menu and respond to reviews
Acceptance_Criteria: Businesses can claim and manage their listings

Title: Hurricane Tracking Overlay
Evidence: Residents need storm tracks alongside incident reports during hurricane season
Recommended_Action: Add hurricane layer showing NHC forecast tracks
Acceptance_Criteria: Hurricane tracks displayed on map during storm season
